root_cause: Distinct Composio projects and OAuth grants were treated as interchangeable by an external observer. Multiple chat LinkedIn profiles returned 403 on organization ACL while the separately bound production Composio account proved a company post. The setup create_link path could reuse a saved OAuth auth_config_id without validating its organization scopes, and a personal-only probe wrote ambiguous ACTIVE status.

evidence.chat_connection_org_probe: 3 of 3 organization ACL calls HTTP 403 while personal profile read succeeded
evidence.make: 25 inventoried scenarios; one active on-demand Instagram scenario

intervention: Scope-validate reused LinkedIn OAuth auth-config IDs before presenting a new company reconnect link. Persist company-specific capability state instead of personal-only ACTIVE, expose sanitized organization probe classification and production-bound authority origin; preserve protected actual provider writes and readback.
guardrails: Never expose OAuth token or API key
Never swap the production-bound Composio account for an unverified chat connection
Never republish a previously proven organization post
Never introduce a second heartbeat or social publisher
Preserve existing personal, company, Instagram and blog channel isolation
closure_required: protected PR CI on exact head
production state readback on canonical Composio account
